thread:
ana (Partnerships): KernelWorks + CloudScale asked us to support a partner-managed SA-west1 region for Redwood Dedicated. They want a marketplace listing + nodepool certification. Target window: ~6 weeks. Need owner for quota, KMS, perf validation.

jordan (Cloud): I'll own quota + KMS integration. Need exact SKUs + expected egress. Any constraints on burst?

sam (EngInfra): For latency targets we should require SR-IOV + pcie passthrough where available. Recommend nodeprofile: 24GB GPU, 12 vCPU host, 800GB NVMe. Share perf baseline and we'll validate.

maria (Product): KernelWorks expects a p99 SLA for 2k token workloads. Do we run perf harness in partner staging or ask them to run?

sam (EngInfra): We prefer running it ourselves in partner staging to avoid env variability. I'll need read-only staging creds and network access. Plan: KV-cache warm + 8-hour stress with p99 tail analysis.

tom (Ops): Marketplace metadata checklist: region id, supported SKUs, pricing options, SLA text, KMS modes. I'll prepare a wire copy. Also need to confirm reserved capacity SKU names.

lee (Legal): We'll need a DPA + KMS key authority clause for partner-managed infra. Also define incident notification window (30m for Sev1) and RCA obligations. I can produce a draft SOW addendum in 3 business days.

ana (Partnerships): KernelWorks sent SKU mapping: 
```
- gpu: cloudscale-v100x
- cpu: n2d-highcpu-16
- disk: 1x1TB NVMe
- network: 25Gb SR-IOV
- region_label: sa-west1
```
Can infra confirm compatibility?

sam (EngInfra): cloudscale-v100x maps to our 24GB profile; compatibility OK. We'll recommend 32GB variants for long-context models. Will run regressions.

jordan (Cloud): Partner asked for initial 80 GPUs with burst to 160 during launch week. I'll file quota request today (ref CS-REQ-9987). Need internal sign-off to reserve commit.

sam (EngInfra): 80 GPUs is reasonable. Suggest split across two nodepools for failover: pool-A 40, pool-B 40. We'll validate failover latency.

maria (Product): Marketing wants a joint announcement, but only after perf + security checklist pass. KernelWorks wants co-branded one-pager. Hold announcement until week 6 post-validation.

ana: Can everyone add ETAs here so I can sync with KernelWorks?

sam (EngInfra): Perf harness start Tue 09:00 PT; initial p99 report Wed EOD. Full 8h stability by Thu morning.

jordan (Cloud): Quota request submitted to CloudScale rep. ETA 48h. KMS workflow doc uploaded to drive.

lee (Legal): DPA + KMS clause draft by Thu EOD.

tom (Ops): Marketplace draft + low-latency SKU tag by Wed AM.

maria (Product): I'll draft co-brand one-pager by Thu and hold until perf green.

deploy-bot: [job] perf-harness/run-452 queued by sam  logs will stream here.

ana (Partnerships): Thanks all 44d I'll notify KernelWorks after quota ack and schedule kickoff Mon 10am PT if green. Ping me for blockers.

sam (EngInfra): Quick checklist I'll maintain: [x] SR-IOV enabled [ ] KV-cache warm script attached [ ] 8h stability run [ ] pool failover test across A/B

jordan (Cloud): I'll include burst policy and quota reservation terms in partner doc.

ana (Partnerships): One more ask from KernelWorks: can we offer an "ultra-low-latency" tag for qualifying nodepools? Ops, legal - any blockers?

tom (Ops): We can add SKU tags; need to ensure pricing & SLA reflect it. No blocker technically.

lee (Legal): No legal blocker, but we should define objective criteria for the tag in the SOW (p99 threshold, NIC type, network topology).

ana (Partnerships): Perfect. I'll collate and share an action tracker. Thanks team.
